Name: NPC_MATERIAL_PARAM_ST
Description: Material parameter overrides for characters. Each row sets the values of a material extension parameter on one material (or all materials) of the model.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Network Test Version
Fields.Description: Exclude this row from the network test build.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Release Version
Fields.Description: Exclude this row from the retail build.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Reserve 1
Fields.Description: Reserved export flag for package builds.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Reserve 2
Fields.Description: Reserved export flag for package builds.

Fields.Name: Material Ex Param ID
Fields.Description: ID of the material extension parameter (MaterialExParam) whose values Param 0 to 3 set.

Fields.Name: Color: Red
Fields.Description: Value of parameter 0. For a colour, the red channel.

Fields.Name: Color: Green
Fields.Description: Value of parameter 1. For a colour, the green channel.

Fields.Name: Color: Blue
Fields.Description: Value of parameter 2. For a colour, the blue channel.

Fields.Name: Color: Intensity
Fields.Description: Value of parameter 3. For a colour, the intensity.

Fields.Name: Material ID
Fields.Description: The material ID to be used (the ID set in the matxml) - Use -1 for all materials.
